70683043.description: Droxinavir was an experimental protease inhibitor researched by Pharmacia as a treatment for HIV infection. Its research and development was discontinued on March 06, 1995.

70808995.name: 3,5-Difluoro-4-hydroxybenzylidene imidazolinone
70808995.description: 3,5-Difluoro-4-hydroxybenzylidene imidazolinone or DFHBI is an imidazolinone fluorophore used in various biochemical studies.

71435043.name: Involutin
71435043.description: Involutin is an organic compound that can be found in mushrooms belonging to the genus Paxillus.

71582755.name: 4-AHP
71582755.description: 4-AHP, also known as 4- -1-hydroxypyrazole, is a synthetic GABAA receptor agonist related to the alkaloid and Amanita muscaria constituent muscimol.

72192163.name: Dazucorilant
72192163.description: Dazucorilant is an example of a selective glucocorticoid receptor modulator that is in clinical development.

82286499.name: Methylenedioxyphenmetrazine
82286499.description: 3,4-Methylenedioxyphenmetrazine is a recreational designer drug with stimulant effects.

87571363.name: Vesugen
87571363.description: Vesugen is a tripeptide with the sequence KED or Lys-Glu-Asp.

100952227.name: Cyclic 3-hydroxymelatonin
100952227.description: Cyclic 3-hydroxymelatonin is a metabolite of melatonin and an antioxidant more potent than melatonin.

101215395.name: SXC-2023
101215395.description: SXC-2023 is a cystine–glutamate antiporter activator or glutamate modulator which is under development for the treatment of impulse control disorders such as trichotillomania .

102129315.name: DNaM
102129315.description: dNaM is an artificial nucleobase containing a 3-methoxy-2-naphthyl group instead of a natural base.

121230755.name: 25F-NBOMe
121230755.description: 25F-NBOMe, also known as 2C-F-NBOMe or NBOMe-2C-F as well as N- -4-fluoro-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist and possible serotonergic psychedelic of the...

124385827.name: RU-2309
124385827.description: RU-2309, also known as 18-methylmetribolone, δ9,11-17α,18-dimethyl-19-nortestosterone, or 17α,18-dimethylestr-4,9,11-trien-17β-ol-3-one, is a 17α-alkylated androgen/anabolic steroid of the...

126646947.name: Mirivadelgat
126646947.description: Mirivadelgat is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Foresee Pharmaceuticals for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension. It is an aldehyde dehydrogenase 2 activator.

129844515.name: Lysergic acid cyclobutylamide
129844515.description: Lysergic acid cyclobutylamide , also known as N-cyclobutyllysergamide , is a semisynthetic lysergamide that is synthesized from naturally occurring ergot alkaloids found in Claviceps purpurea.

135146787.name: INCB086550
135146787.description: INCB086550 is a drug that is a small-molecule inhibitor of programmed death-ligand 1 .

139201059.name: Ammonium tetrathioarsenate
139201059.description: Ammonium tetrathioarsenate is a chemical compound with the chemical formula 3AsS4.

146156323.name: Ganoderol A
146156323.description: Ganoderol A is a triterpene isolated from Ganoderma lucidum.

163192739.name: 2C-CP
163192739.description: 2C-CP, or 2C-cP, also known as 4-cyclopropyl-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic and designer drug of the phenethylamine and 2C families.

165889699.name: 5-MAPBT
165889699.description: 5-MAPBT, also known as 5-(2- propyl)-1-benzothiophene, is a possible entactogen of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and benzothiophene families.

170763683.name: 1P-MiPLA
170763683.description: 1P-MiPLA, also known as 1-propanoyl-lysergic acid methylisopropylamide , is a designer drug and presumed serotonergic psychedelic of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide .

177697059.name: Lithium hexafluorostannate
177697059.description: Lithium hexafluorostannate is an inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula Li2SnF6.

900000035.name: 2CBecca
900000035.description: 2CBecca, also known as 4- -1,2,3,4-tetrahydroisoquinoline, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, and N-benzylphenethylamine families.

900000163.name: Ammonium polyphosphate
900000163.description: Ammonium polyphosphate is an inorganic salt of polyphosphoric acid and ammonia containing both chains and possibly branching.

900000291.name: Bis(dimethoxyethane)neptunium tetrachloride
900000291.description: Bis neptunium tetrachloride is a chemical compound with the chemical formula NpCl4 2 , and a dimethoxyethane adduct of neptunium chloride .

900000419.name: Carotuximab
900000419.description: Carotuximab is a chimeric monoclonal antibody designed for the treatment of cancer. This drug was developed by Tracon Pharmaceuticals Inc. It is at Phase III trials for angiosarcoma.

900000547.name: DPT vaccine
900000547.description: The DPT vaccine or DTP vaccine is a class of combination vaccines to protect against three infectious diseases in humans: diphtheria, pertussis , and tetanus .

900000931.name: Hepatitis A and B vaccine
900000931.description: Combined hepatitis A and B vaccine, is used to provide protection against hepatitis A and hepatitis B.

900001059.name: Izokibep
900001059.description: Izokibep is an investigational small protein therapeutic designed to selectively inhibit interleukin-17A , a pro-inflammatory cytokine implicated in various autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

900001187.name: Luteinizing hormone
900001187.description: Luteinizing hormone (LH, also known as luteinising hormone, lutropin and sometimes lutrophin) is a hormone produced by gonadotropic cells in the anterior pituitary gland.

900001443.name: Otlertuzumab
900001443.description: Otlertuzumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody that targets CD37 designed for the treatment of cancer.

900001571.name: Plutonium oxyfluoride
900001571.description: Plutonium oxyfluoride is an inorganic compound of plutonium, oxygen, and fluorine with the chemical formula PuOF.

900001699.name: Praseodymium monosulfide
900001699.description: Praseodymium monosulfide is a binary inorganic chemical compound of praseodymium metal and sulfur with the chemical formula PrS.

900001955.name: TRISPHAT
900001955.description: TRISPHAT (full name tris phosphate ) is an inorganic anion with the formula P 3−, often prepared as the tributylammonium ( 3NH+) or tetrabutylammonium ( 4N+) salt.

900002083.name: Tritellurium dichloride
900002083.description: Tritellurium dichloride is the inorganic compound with the formula Te3Cl2. It is one of the more stable lower chlorides of tellurium.

900002211.name: Zirconium silicon sulfide
900002211.description: Zirconium silicon sulfide is a crystalline layered Dirac semi-metal compound of zirconium, silicon and sulfur.
